craft_notes: Sthāyin: helpers-insufficient within vīra of workshop disputation (all 9 verses verified present; lines = L3 verbatim). Sanskrit-first: na eva (NEVER indeed — kept); praveśāt sahakāribhiḥ (BY-ENTERING-WITH-HELPERS — kept); śakyaḥ kartum kṣamam (COULD-BE-WROUGHT-ABLE — kept concessive). Rows: 9 (never/could-able — denial + concession in one breath), 1 (‘able though they be’ closes). Close: ‘able though they be’. Rupture: em-dash. Rejected: ‘capable’ for able — killed; merging never/could — killed. Read aloud: NEV-er — BY-en-ter-ing MATT-er's in-SIDE WITH-help-ERS — … COULD ar-RAY be-WROUGHT — A-ble THOUGH they-BE.

lines: Never — by entering matter's inside with helpers —
could array be wrought — able though they be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: naivopādanahetvantaḥ praveśātsahakāribhiḥ saṃniveśaviśeṣo'pi śakyaḥ kartumiti kṣamam

reads_against.argmap: Can helpers entering matter arrange? → Entering matter with helpers can't make arrangement — ability aside.
c1_essence: Potter necessary, nature watching, helpers insufficient, wisdom and will required, sufficiency tested (vv28-33).
Array excels by ends; Lord and un-Lord fenced off atomically; pradhāna will-less yet person-aim-ness stands (vv34-36).
